content.text: Updated (456 chars)

Diagnosed and fixed.

## Root cause

Bare frontmatter is converted into fenced YAML before being handed to `pulldown-cmark`.

The bug was in `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` in `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`: it was cleaning the detected bare header by dropping every line that started with a space:

```rust
.lines()
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

That preserved simple scalar metadata like:

```yaml
title: Task A
status: ready
```

but corrupted valid YAML sequences:

```yaml
depends:
  - foo
```

by deleting the indented sequence item. The metadata stored in the graph became effectively:

```yaml
depends:
```

so `iwe find --meta depends=foo` found no sequence value to match.

Fenced frontmatter did not go through this bare-frontmatter wrapping path, so fenced YAML worked.

## Fix

Changed `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` to preserve YAML indentation and only trim trailing whitespace from the detected header block:

```rust
let cleaned_header = header.trim_end();

if rest.is_empty() {
    Cow::Owned(format!("---\n{}\n---\n", cleaned_header))
} else {
    Cow::Owned(format!("---\n{}\n---\n\n{}", cleaned_header, rest))
}
```

This keeps nested YAML valid while still avoiding extra trailing whitespace before the inserted closing fence.

## Regression test added

Added a focused test in `crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs`:

```rust
#[test]
fn value_in_bare_yaml_sequence_matches() {
    let graph = setup_bare_graph(indoc! {"
        title: Task A
        depends:
          - foo

        # Task A
    "});

    let finder = DocumentFinder::new(&graph);
    let options = FindOptions {
        metadata_filters: vec![("depends".to_string(), "foo".to_string())],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let output = finder.find(&options);
    assert_eq!(output.results.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(output.results[0].title, "Task A");
}
```

Also added `setup_bare_graph()` helper using `MarkdownOptions { bare_frontmatter: true, ..Default::default() }`.

## Verification

Ran:

```bash
cargo test -p liwe value_in_bare_yaml_sequence_matches -- --nocapture
```

Result: passed.

Ran full workspace tests:

```bash
cargo test
```

Result: passed, including all crate and doc tests.

## Worktree note

`cargo fmt` produced broad formatting churn across the already-dirty workspace. I did **not** perform destructive cleanup because that could overwrite unrelated pre-existing changes. The bug-fix content is limited to:

- `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`
- `crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs`
